concept.zh: 有符号区间的计数与最短长度
concept.en: Counting signed intervals and finding their shortest length

brief.zh: changes 记录每一拍的电量增减。找出所有总变化正好为 target 的非空连续区间，返回 [区间数量, 最短区间长度]。位置不同分别计数。区间可以重叠，电量可以为负或为零。没有符合条件的区间时返回 [0, 0]。
brief.en: changes lists the signed charge changes over time. Find all nonempty consecutive bands totaling target. Return [number of bands, shortest band length]. Count different positions separately. Bands may overlap, and values can be negative or zero. Return [0, 0] if none match.

label.zh: 保留每个累计值的首次位置
label.en: Keep the first position for each total
